caption: A backpack is hooked to a bungee cord hanging from a beam and let go; the cord stretches, the pack bounces back up, and it bobs up and down before settling.

sa.check: A backpack is hooked to a bungee cord hanging from a beam.
It bobs up and down before settling.
The release comes first, then the stretch, then the bounces.

pc.expect: The cord lengthens as the pack drops and shortens as it rises, and it does not go slack while the pack hangs.
pc.fail: The cord is rigid; or slack while the pack hangs; or it snaps.

pc.expect: Each bounce is smaller than the last and the pack never rises above the point where it was released.
pc.fail: It rises above the release point; or the bounces grow; or it swings far sideways.

pc.expect: Nothing touches it after the release.
pc.fail: It is pushed; or restarts after settling; or jumps.

pc.expect: The pack hangs below the beam.
pc.fail: It rises above the beam; or floats; or hangs sideways.

pc.expect: One pack and one cord keep their number.
pc.fail: The pack duplicates; or the cord vanishes; or the pack turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pack and the beam stay the same.
pc.fail: The pack changes colour; or the beam changes; or the room rearranges.
